doc: blender/README.md + docs/phase6/review/gates/README.md. Keys: gate_<obby|ring|arena|dungeon|altar> (type prop 'gate', kit/props/gates.py; P4 hoop family, contract 6.0.3) and gate_home (prop 'gate_homestead', kit/props/gates_homestead.py: the same BuildGate contract in the homestead family of gate_homeportal, polish 2026-10-27). One key per gate kind, shared by every BuildGate call of that glyph (lobby, arena Ring / Arena / Return, dungeon portal): gate_home dresses the arena's green Return gate. Pivot = the gate site; WorldStyle.BuildGate tags the gate model (ML_Offset (0, -11.5, 0)). The Neon glow ring / swirl / gems stay Parts. gate_homeportal (prop 'home_portal', kit/props/gates_homeportal.py) is the player's personal home portal of client/Controllers/HomePortalFx (MeshLibrary.Assemble on the client, Part fallback there); not a BuildGate gate.

keys.description: Nimbus Climb Sky Obby gate: hoop + 5-star crest (stone, cloud frame, coloured band, crest; Neon parts stay in Roblox)
Nimbus Climb Champion Ring gate: the crowned arch (stone, cloud frame, coloured band, crest; Neon parts stay in Roblox)
Nimbus Climb Battle Arena gate: hoop + shield and crossed swords (stone, cloud frame, coloured band, crest; Neon parts stay in Roblox)
Nimbus Climb Dungeon gate: hoop + skull over crossed bones (stone, cloud frame, coloured band, crest; Neon parts stay in Roblox)

Nimbus Climb Home / Return gate in the homestead family: coursed stone, oak hoop with bronze straps in the gate-colour band, enamel plate with a brass cottage and porch lanterns (Neon parts stay in Roblox)
Nimbus Climb Storm Altar gate: hoop + storm cloud (stone, cloud frame, coloured band, crest; Neon parts stay in Roblox)
Nimbus Climb home portal: the player's homestead gate (coursed stone pillars, oak arch with bronze straps, keystone plate in the portal colour, ivy; the Neon vortex stays in Roblox)
